column3: The Hebrew leaves the subject unnamed here; BSB names Manasseh.
The Hebrew says he made his sons pass through the fire in the valley of the son of Hinnom; BSB says he sacrificed them and shortens the valley’s name.
The Hebrew leaves the subject unnamed here and says “this house”; BSB names Manasseh and says “this temple.”
The Hebrew says “the foot of Israel”; BSB says “the feet of the Israelites.”
The Hebrew speaks of hooks in the plural without specifying the nose; BSB specifies a hook in his nose.
The Hebrew leaves the subject unnamed here and says he entreated the LORD’s face; BSB names Manasseh and says he sought the LORD’s favor.
The Hebrew leaves the hearer unnamed here; BSB explicitly names the LORD.
The Hebrew says “built” and leaves the subject unnamed; BSB says “rebuilt” and names Manasseh.
The Hebrew names Hosai at the end; BSB refers to the Seers.
The Hebrew says “they buried him” and “his house”; BSB uses “was buried” and says “his palace.”
The Hebrew says “his servants” and “his house”; BSB names Amon and says “his palace.”
The Hebrew repeats “the people of the land”; BSB uses “they” for the second occurrence.
